title: RITA configuration
description: Schema for RITA's config.hjson. The file itself is HJSON (comments and relaxed syntax allowed); this schema validates its JSON-equivalent. Bounds are derived from the validate tags on the Config struct in config/config.go. Additional/unknown keys are allowed so the schema can lag behind new optional settings.

config_version.description: Optional config schema version. Omit (or 0) for unversioned. A value greater than the RITA build's CurrentConfigVersion is rejected.

update_check_enabled.description: Whether RITA checks GitHub for a newer release on startup.

batch_size.description: Number of rows buffered before a batch is flushed to ClickHouse. Larger values use more memory but reduce insert overhead.

max_query_execution_time.description: ClickHouse max_execution_time (seconds) applied to analysis queries.

months_to_keep_historical_first_seen.description: How many months of historical first-seen data to retain.

online_feeds.description: URLs of online threat-intel feeds (one IP or domain per line in each feed).

internal_subnets.description: CIDR ranges considered internal. Required and non-empty.

always_included_subnets.description: CIDR ranges to always include regardless of other filters.

never_included_subnets.description: CIDR ranges to always exclude. Required and non-empty.

filter_external_to_internal.description: Whether to drop external-to-internal connections during import.

beacon.description: Beacon-detection scoring. The four weight fields should sum to 1.

unique_connection_threshold.description: Minimum unique connections before a pair is eligible for beacon analysis.

modifiers.description: Score modifiers applied on top of base indicator scores. All *_score_increase values are in the range 0..1.

name_server.description: host:port of the name server (required when enabled).

weight.description: A score weight or increment in the range 0..1.

scoreThresholds.description: Graduated severity buckets. Values must be strictly increasing: base < low < medium < high.

scoreImpact.description: Binary-indicator impact: a severity category and its score contribution.
